_about: The course calendar (assets/schedule.js on the site, worker.js in the bot, post_day.py for the mentor). One lesson per study day in 'order' (Monday to Friday, or every day when 'weekends' is true); each opens at 00:00 Tashkent time and its homework closes at 23:59 on its due day: the same day, or the later lesson 'due' names (the plan's due days), or a date 'due' gives as YYYY-MM-DD. 'start' = the first study day of the walk (YYYY-MM-DD); null = no schedule, everything open. 'dates' pins a lesson to its own day outside the walk. 'with' opens a lesson on the same day as another without taking a study day (each Day 6 exam opens with its Day 5 and is due on the next week's Day 1). 'off' = days without a lesson: every later lesson moves one study day on. The practice day is never scheduled. Since 2026-11-02 (her wish, through the founder): Monday to Friday, restarting at Week 1 Day 2, which opens on 2026-11-02 and keeps Tuesday too; from Wednesday 2026-11-04 Day 3, 4, 5 fall on Wednesday to Friday, and from Week 2 every Day N falls on the weekday the lessons' stories name.
